name: blackbox
description: Replay a Pi --mode json agent log as a timeline, with Clef scoring the step where the run went wrong.

scripts.lint: git submodule update --init --quiet tools/anti-slop && biome check . && oxlint
scripts.verify: bun run check && bun run lint && bun run copy-check && bun run test
scripts.deploy:prod: vite build && wrangler deploy -c core/wrangler.prod.jsonc && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.prod.jsonc
